correctness.rationale: The support condition follows from the vertices of a cube truncated at sum<=n-1 and a conditional completion coupling. Independent normalized-uniform rows reduce to independent deficits. Their density is bounded by an explicitly normalized power times (1-d)^(-n), equality below 1/2. Dirichlet comparison yields A_n=1/(n^n[n(n-1)]!), concentration gives W/e^n→e^(1/2), uniform exponential moments justify the mean, and beta tails suppress exceptional corners. For n=2, q_2=1/2 separately. 259 executed finite checks support the calculation but do not certify the asymptotic.
